profile_text.body:
SoftBank Group Corp. is a Tokyo-based public company founded in 1981, listed under the ticker SFTBF. Its Japanese-language site identifies it by its English name, SoftBank Group Corp., and names Masayoshi Son as representative director, chairman and CEO. The site presents the company's philosophy, vision and strategy, corporate information, shareholder and investor relations material, business segments and group companies, and sustainability and ESG information.

The site also describes the company's thinking in what it calls the era of the AI revolution, along with the efforts of group companies and the possibilities it sees in AI. Beyond that framing, the material available does not name specific AI products or services. The company's profile records a CIK of 0001065521 and a for-profit, public-company structure.
